_comment: Zero-shot external validation on the Mendeley LBC Roboflow export (src/mendeley_external.py).
preprocessing: CLAHE on L channel (clip 2.0, 8x8 tiles), area resize to 384 x 512, ImageNet normalisation
tta: mean of softmax over original, horizontal flip and vertical flip, at network resolution
cell_rule: abnormal if mean P(abnormal) > mean P(normal) inside the reference box (boxes rescaled to 384 x 512)
image_score: 99.5th percentile of the abnormal-class probability map
statistics: image-level (cluster) bootstrap 95% CI; paired bootstrap of AUC differences; Holm correction

few_shot_adaptation.note: Exploratory, not reported in the paper
